headword: {首脳会談|しゅのうかいだん}

definitions.explanation: A meeting between the leaders of two or more countries, such as presidents or prime ministers. A standard term in news reports on diplomacy.

examples.japanese: {首脳会談|しゅのうかいだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧{首脳会談|しゅのうかいだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A Japan–U.S. summit will be held next month.
